title: ClientError string variants lose structured error data
description: ClientError::Parse(String), InvalidArgument(String), MethodNotFound(String), and InvalidSession(String) all wrap formatted strings instead of structured fields. For Parse in particular, serde_json::Error carries position (line/column), error kind, and path — all lost by .map_err(|e| ClientError::Parse(e.to_string())). Callers cannot recover error structure, match on error kind, or display position info without re-parsing the message string. The thiserror #[from] path for serde_json::Error already exists (via the Serialize variant) but is not used for parse-side errors. At minimum, a ClientError::ParseResponse(serde_json::Error) variant would let callers inspect what failed and why. Without it, debugging server response shape mismatches requires correlating string messages manually.
